name: Clicks Admin Toolkit
author: sykologicist

sections.description:
Clicks Admin Toolkit packs 139+ toggleable modules into a single high-speed dashboard — replacing 20 to 30 plugins with zero performance overhead.

Every module is 100% free with zero upsells, zero locked features, and zero nag banners.

The Problem Solved

Standard WordPress sites install dozens of single-purpose plugins for post cloning, SVG uploads, SMTP mail, login throttling, emoji removal, maintenance mode, redirects, and WooCommerce tweaks — slowing wp-admin with bloated scripts and background queries.

Clicks Admin Toolkit replaces them all with one lightweight suite that stores all settings in a single autoloaded database row.

High-Performance Architecture

  • Zero Overhead: Inactive modules are never loaded; zero hooks registered.
  • Single Database Row: All 139+ module states live in sasuite_settings, costing one query during bootstrap.
  • Native APIs: Built on WordPress Settings, Media Library, Transients, and WP_Filesystem.

7 Executive Dashboard Widgets

  1. File Integrity Radar: Monitors core, themes, and plugins against SHA-256 hashes.
  2. Brute-Force & Login Radar: Displays throttled IPs and failed login attempts.
  3. Outbound Mail Deliverability: Tracks sent vs failed emails and SMTP connectivity health.
  4. Admin Activity Stream: Audit trail of post edits, role changes, and plugin toggles.
  5. Broken Links Sentinel: Summarizes 404 links and broken external hyperlinks.
  6. Database Health Inspector: Overview of database overhead with 1-click cleanup.
  7. REST API Traffic Monitor: Live counter of REST requests and blocked scrapers.

1-Click Starter Preset Packs

  • Agency Starter: Cleans wp-admin, suppresses update nags, enables duplicate post, and clean filenames.
  • Maximum Security Shield: REST rate limiting, comment honeypot, user enum blocking, and XML-RPC disabling.
  • Speed & Core Web Vitals: Strips emojis and query strings; throttles Heartbeat; enables lazy-loading.
  • High-Converting Store Pack: Direct checkout, sticky buy bar, free shipping progress bar, and order notes.

Complete Breakdown of All 139+ Modules by Category

📂 Content & Media (22 Modules)

  • Duplicate Post / Page / CPT: 1-click clone posts, pages, or CPTs into draft.
  • Safe SVG Uploads & Sanitizer: XML-sanitized SVG uploads preventing XXE and XSS.
  • Media File In-Place Replacement: Replace media files preserving attachment IDs and URLs.
  • Media Categories & Taxonomies: Adds categories and tags to the Media Library.
  • Restrict Media to Own Uploads: Authors only see their own uploaded media.
  • Drag & Drop Post Reordering: Reorder posts, pages, and CPTs via drag-and-drop.
  • Enable Page Excerpts: Native excerpt support on standard WordPress pages.
  • External Links in New Tab: Adds target=”_blank” and rel=”noopener” to outbound links.
  • Auto Image Alt & Title Fallback: Fills empty image alt/title tags from titles.
  • Clean Image Filename Sanitizer: Converts upload filenames into clean lowercase SEO slugs.
  • Editorial Publishing Calendar: Visual calendar for drafts, scheduled, and published posts.
  • Bulk Image WebP Compressor: Lossless compression with automatic WebP conversion on upload.
  • Broken Link Checker & Crawler: Link crawler with 1-click broken link fixes.
  • 301/302 Redirect Manager & 404 Log: Slug change redirects and 404 error logs.
  • Enhanced Password Protected Pages: Branded layout for password-protected post pages.
  • Disable Gutenberg Per Post Type: Selectively restores Classic Editor per post type.
  • Lightweight Social Share Buttons: SVG share buttons for X, Facebook, WhatsApp.
  • Reading Time Estimator: Displays calculated reading duration badge on articles.
  • Custom Post Statuses: Custom workflow statuses like In Review or Approved.
  • Media EXIF & GPS Metadata Stripper: Strips camera metadata and GPS coordinates on upload.
  • Automatic Image Watermarking: Applies PNG watermark logos to uploaded media.
  • Smart 404 Auto-Redirect: Redirects 404s to closest matching published slug.

📂 Admin UI & Menus (11 Modules)

  • Admin Menu Organizer: Rename, reorder, or hide admin menu items.
  • Admin Toolbar Cleaner: Strips WP logo, comments, updates, and greeting.
  • Custom Admin Favicon: Dedicated wp-admin favicon via WordPress Media Library.
  • Custom Admin Columns: Add Post ID, Featured Image, and Slug columns.
  • Show Last Modified Date & Author: Displays last modified timestamp and editor in tables.
  • Sticky List Table Headers: Pins column headers while scrolling long tables.
  • Wider Admin List Tables: Expands admin tables to full widescreen width.
  • Admin Footer Customizer: Customize or hide admin footer copyright text.
  • Admin Dark Mode: High-contrast dark theme across WordPress backend.
  • Custom Admin Bar Quick Links: Add custom shortcuts and support links to toolbar.
  • Admin Bookmark & Favorites Sidebar: Pin favorite admin pages with star icons.

📂 Dashboard & Notice Control (11 Modules)

  • Admin Notice Drawer: Collapses plugin notices into a slide-out tray.
  • Disable Notices by Role: Suppress plugin banners for non-administrator roles.
  • Disable Gutenberg Fullscreen: Keeps admin sidebar visible when editing blocks.
  • Disable Default Dashboard Widgets: Turn off Welcome Panel, Quick Draft, and Events.
  • Custom Dashboard Welcome Widget: Branded rich-text welcome notices for client onboarding.
  • Highlight Duplicate Titles: Warning badges when posts share identical titles.
  • Disable Block Directory Search: Stops Block Editor from querying WordPress.org blocks.
  • Admin Quick Search (Ctrl+K): Instant spotlight search to jump to settings.
  • Disable Update Nag for Non-Admins: Hides core update notices from non-administrators.
  • Quick Frontend/Backend Switcher: 1-click button to jump between view and edit.
  • Custom Broadcast Notice Creator: Broadcast targeted admin announcements by role.

📂 Login, 2FA & Access Control (14 Modules)

  • Custom Secret Login URL: Move wp-login.php to custom slug to block bots.
  • Custom Login Page Styler: Brand login screen with custom logo and colors.
  • Limit Login Attempts & IP Lockout: Throttles failed attempts and blocks abusive IPs.
  • Email-Only or Username-Only Login: Restrict login identifiers to prevent credential guessing.
  • Role-Based Login Redirects: Custom landing URLs for users after login.
  • Role-Based Logout Redirects: Custom landing URLs for users upon logout.
  • Two-Factor Authentication (2FA TOTP): RFC 6238 TOTP 2FA for Authenticator apps.
  • Emergency 2FA Recovery Codes: Single-use backup keys for 2FA account recovery.
  • Hide Login Screen Links: Hides password reset and back to blog links.
  • Auto-Logout Idle Sessions: Automatically terminates inactive user sessions after timeout.
  • Login Cloudflare Turnstile & reCAPTCHA: Bot protection on login and registration forms.
  • One-Time Magic Login Links: Cryptographic single-use links for client login.
  • Login Lockout Countdown: Live countdown timer on wp-login.php during lockout.
  • Session Timeout Warning Modal: Inactivity warning modal with stay logged in button.

📂 Security & Hardening (15 Modules)

  • Disable XML-RPC: Blocks xmlrpc.php against brute-force attacks and DDoS.
  • Hide WordPress Version: Removes version generator tags from head and scripts.
  • Disable File Editor: Enforces DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT to block file editing.
  • Anti-Spam Comment Honeypot: Invisible honeypot catches spam bots without CAPTCHAs.
  • Block Author Enumeration: Blocks /?author=N scans and user enumeration scans.
  • Restrict REST API: Locks down REST API endpoints to authenticated users.
  • Admin Login Alert from New IP: Email alerts when admin logs in from new IP.
  • Obscure Login Errors: Replaces login errors with generic credentials notice.
  • Disable Self-Pingbacks: Stops WordPress from sending self-pingback requests.
  • Disable Application Passwords: Prevents application password generation for non-admins.
  • Content Security Policy (CSP) Manager: GUI builder for CSP and security headers.
  • File Change & Integrity Monitor: Scans core, theme, and plugin files for modifications.
  • Right-Click & Copy Protection: Disables text selection, right-click, and copy shortcuts.
  • REST API Rate Limiter: Throttles abusive REST requests returning HTTP 429.
  • Disposable Burner Email Blocker: Blocks registrations and checkouts from burner emails.

📂 Speed & Performance (11 Modules)

  • Disable Emojis & DNS Prefetch: Removes core emoji scripts and DNS prefetch calls.
  • Heartbeat API Controller: Throttles background Heartbeat AJAX from 15s to 120s.
  • Limit Post Revisions: Caps revision count per post type to save database space.
  • Autosave Interval Controller: Extends autosave interval to slash server write load.
  • Clean Up Junk: Removes RSD, WLW manifest, shortlinks, and generator tags.
  • Disable RSS / Atom Feeds: Disables RSS feeds with homepage redirect if unused.
  • Defer JavaScript: Defers non-essential scripts for higher PageSpeed scores.
  • Remove Query Strings: Strips ?ver= query strings to improve CDN caching.
  • Disable Frontend Dashicons: Prevents dashicons.min.css from loading for visitors.
  • Disable Legacy jQuery Migrate: Removes unnecessary legacy jQuery script on modern themes.
  • Native Lazy Loading Engine: Injects native loading=”lazy” on images and iframes.

📂 WooCommerce Enhancements (19 Modules)

  • Disable Marketplace Nags: Strips marketplace suggestions, inbox tips, and promo banners.
  • Show Product Thumbnail & SKU: Displays thumbnails and SKUs in Orders list table.
  • Direct Checkout (Skip Cart): Redirects Add to Cart directly to Checkout.
  • Auto-Complete Virtual Orders: Automatically marks virtual and downloadable orders Completed.
  • Hide Shipping When Free Available: Hides paid shipping rates once free shipping applies.
  • Custom “Add to Cart” Text: Customize button text globally or by product type.
  • One-Click Empty Cart Button: Adds clear cart action button on Cart page.
  • Delete Expired Coupons & Transients: 1-click purge for expired promo coupons and carts.
  • Custom Currency Symbol & Position: Custom currency symbol display and positioning.
  • Custom Thank You Redirection: Redirect buyers to custom landing pages post-purchase.
  • WooCommerce Quick Order Notes: Inline modal to view and add private order notes.
  • Low Stock Alert System: Automated email alerts when inventory falls below threshold.
  • Minimum Order Amount Enforcer: Blocks checkout if cart subtotal is below minimum.
  • Sticky Mobile “Buy Now” Bar: Fixed bottom checkout bar on mobile product pages.
  • GeoIP Multi-Currency Switcher: Auto-detects customer currency with live exchange rates.
  • Free Shipping Progress Bar: Progress bar showing amount needed for free shipping.
  • Slide-Out Cart Drawer: AJAX mini-cart drawer opening on Add to Cart.
  • WooCommerce Test Order Generator: Generate mock test orders with customer data.
  • Custom Order Statuses: Registers custom workflow statuses like Awaiting Pickup or Shipped.

📂 User Management & Roles (10 Modules)

  • User Last Login Tracker: Displays last login timestamp and IP in Users table.
  • Force Password Change on Next Login: Requires users to reset password on login.
  • Disable New User Admin Emails: Stops admin notifications from high-volume user signups.
  • Hide Admin Bar by Role: Removes admin toolbar on frontend for specific roles.
  • Restrict /wp-admin/ by Role: Redirects non-admin roles away from wp-admin to account.
  • Secure 1-Click User Switcher: Switch between user accounts with HMAC SHA-256 tokens.
  • Enforce Display Name Format: Sets public display names to full names, hiding usernames.
  • Terminate All Active Sessions: 1-click logout for all sessions across any account.
  • Prevent Password Reset by Role: Disables password resets for restricted membership roles.
  • Default Registration Role Override: Enforces specific default roles for new user signups.

📂 Email & SMTP Delivery (11 Modules)

  • Built-in SMTP Mailer: Custom SMTP host, port, SSL/TLS, and authentication.
  • From Name & Email Override: Enforces sender name and email on outgoing emails.
  • Outbound Email Logger: Logs every wp_mail() call with recipients and subject.
  • Live SMTP Test Sender: 1-click diagnostic email sender with real-time feedback.
  • HTML Email Wrapper Template: Wraps notifications in a responsive HTML layout.
  • Disable Auto-Update Emails: Suppresses core, theme, and plugin update notifications.
  • Disable Comment Moderation Emails: Stops comment notification emails sent to administrators.
  • Alert on Profile/Email Change: Security alerts when user profile email addresses change.
  • BCC Admin on System Emails: Blind-copy administrator on system notifications.
  • Custom Email Header Logo: Injects brand logo into outgoing email headers via Media.
  • Granular Email Suppression: Selectively suppress specific system emails without code.

📂 Utilities & Maintenance (15 Modules)

  • Maintenance & Coming Soon Mode: Maintenance screen with HTTP 503 headers and whitelist.
  • Site Master Password Gate: Protects entire website behind a password with session expiry.
  • System Health Inspector: Server overview: PHP memory, MySQL version, upload limits.
  • 1-Click Database Optimizer: Cleans expired transients, spam comments, and trash.
  • Safe Database Search & Replace: Safe serialized string replacement with dry-run preview.
  • Admin Activity Audit Log: Tracks admin actions: plugin toggles and settings changes.
  • Floating Scroll to Top Button: Customizable back-to-top button on frontend and admin.
  • Clear Cache Toolbar Button: Instant transient and object cache purge button in toolbar.
  • HTTP 503 Maintenance Header: Sends proper Service Unavailable header during maintenance.
  • Settings JSON Export & Import: 1-click backup and migration of module configurations.
  • Scheduled Database Cleanup (Cron): Automated background maintenance for transients and trash.
  • Cookie Consent & GDPR Banner: Accessible GDPR/CCPA cookie notice banner.
  • Multisite Network Sync: Synchronize module settings across network sites in 1-click.
  • Plugin Auto-Rollback: Automated failsafe against fatal errors caused by updates.
  • 1-Click Database Backup: Compressed SQL database backups with optional email delivery.

Enterprise-Grade Security

  • HMAC SHA-256 Tokens for secure user switching.
  • DOMDocument XML Sanitizer with LIBXML_NONET for safe SVG uploads.
  • WP_Filesystem API for all disk operations — no eval() or move_uploaded_file().
  • Strict Nonces & Permissions on every AJAX action and setting save.
  • Complete Output Escaping across every rendered admin view.

Who Is This Plugin For?

  • Agencies & Freelancers: Configure once, export JSON presets, and deploy across client sites in seconds.
  • WooCommerce Stores: Direct checkout, mobile sticky buy bars, free shipping bars, and cart drawers.
  • Publishers & Creators: Organize media taxonomies, replace images in-place, and plan with an editorial calendar.
  • Security & Speed Seekers: 2FA TOTP, rename login URL, throttle REST abuse, and eliminate script bloat.

100% Free & Open Source

GPLv2 licensed. No Pro version, no locked features, and no trial periods.

Built by Clicks

Clicks Admin Toolkit is maintained by Rayhan Bajwa (@rayhan.bajwa) and Clicks.

  • Website: clicks.com.pk
  • Plugin Page: clicks.com.pk/clicks-admin-toolkit

External services

This plugin conditionally connects to third-party services only if explicitly enabled:

  1. Cloudflare Turnstile (Optional — Login CAPTCHA module)

* Domain: https://challenges.cloudflare.com
* Purpose: Bot and abuse protection on login and registration forms.
* Data sent: Verification token, client IP address, site key.
* Terms of Service: https://www.cloudflare.com/terms/
* Privacy Policy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/

  1. Google reCAPTCHA (Optional — Login CAPTCHA module)

* Domain: https://www.google.com
* Purpose: Spam and bot protection on login and registration forms.
* Data sent: Interaction response token, client IP address, site key.
* Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the clicks-admin-toolkit folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Clicks Admin Toolkit in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Toggle any of the 139+ modules ON, configure its options in the slide-out drawer, and click Save Changes.
  5. Use Ctrl+K or the search bar to instantly find any tool.
sections.faq:
How many modules does Clicks Admin Toolkit include?

Clicks Admin Toolkit includes 139+ individually toggleable modules across 10 categories: Content & Media (22), Admin UI & Menus (11), Dashboard & Notices (11), Login, 2FA & Access (14), Security & Hardening (15), Performance & Cleaner (11), WooCommerce Polish (19), User Roles & Control (10), Email & Notifications (11), and Utilities & Maintenance (15).

Does activating dozens of modules slow down my site?

No! The plugin uses a zero-overhead conditional loader. Disabled modules are never loaded into PHP memory — their files are never included and their hooks are never registered. All settings are stored in a single autoloaded database row, so enabling 1 module or 139 modules costs the exact same: one lightweight database query.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes! Category 7 includes 19 dedicated WooCommerce modules (GeoIP multi-currency switcher, slide-out cart drawer, sticky buy bar, free shipping progress bar, direct checkout, custom order statuses, quick order notes, etc.). These modules only run when WooCommerce is active.

Can I export my configuration and import it on another site?

Yes! Use the built-in Settings Export & Import modal or 1-Click Starter Presets to copy your entire configuration as a JSON string and import it onto any WordPress site running Clicks Admin Toolkit.

Does this plugin run arbitrary PHP code or use eval()?

No. In strict compliance with WordPress.org security policies, this plugin does not use eval(), exec(), shell_exec(), move_uploaded_file(), or arbitrary code evaluation.

Is PHP 8.x and WordPress 7.x supported?

Yes! Fully tested and verified on PHP 7.4 through 8.3+ and WordPress 6.0 through 7.1+.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

All behaviors cleanly revert to WordPress defaults. No core files, tables, or posts are modified. Your settings remain safely preserved in the database if you reactivate later.

Is there a paid or Pro version?

No. All 139+ modules are 100% free and fully unlocked with zero restrictions, zero upsells, and zero advertisements.

  • Added Maintenance & Reliability tools: Automated Scheduled DB Optimizer, Database Backup & Snapshot Generator, and Plugin/Theme Auto-Rollback safeguard.
  • Added interactive “What’s New in v1.1.0” announcement modal with 1-click dismiss.

  • 10 organized categories: Content, Admin UI, Dashboard, Login, Security, Performance, WooCommerce, Users, Email, Utilities.
  • Zero-overhead conditional module loader — disabled modules are never loaded.
  • Single autoloaded database row for all 100+ module configurations.
  • DOMDocument SVG XML sanitizer with LIBXML_NONET XXE prevention.
  • HMAC SHA-256 cryptographic tokens for secure user switching.
  • Native WordPress Media Library integration for all image/asset fields.
  • Full WordPress.org automated review compliance.
  • PHP 7.4 – 8.3 and WordPress 6.0 – 7.1+ compatibility.

  • Show Product Thumbnail & SKU: Displays thumbnails and SKUs in Orders list table.
  • Direct Checkout (Skip Cart): Redirects Add to Cart directly to Checkout.
  • Auto-Complete Virtual Orders: Automatically marks virtual and downloadable orders Completed.
  • Hide Shipping When Free Available: Hides paid shipping rates once free shipping applies.
  • Custom “Add to Cart” Text: Customize button text globally or by product type.
  • One-Click Empty Cart Button: Adds clear cart action button on Cart page.
  • Delete Expired Coupons & Transients: 1-click purge for expired promo coupons and carts.
  • Custom Currency Symbol & Position: Custom currency symbol display and positioning.
  • Custom Thank You Redirection: Redirect buyers to custom landing pages post-purchase.
  • WooCommerce Quick Order Notes: Inline modal to view and add private order notes.
  • Low Stock Alert System: Automated email alerts when inventory falls below threshold.
  • Minimum Order Amount Enforcer: Blocks checkout if cart subtotal is below minimum.
  • Sticky Mobile “Buy Now” Bar: Fixed bottom checkout bar on mobile product pages.
  • GeoIP Multi-Currency Switcher: Auto-detects customer currency with live exchange rates.
  • Free Shipping Progress Bar: Progress bar showing amount needed for free shipping.
  • Slide-Out Cart Drawer: AJAX mini-cart drawer opening on Add to Cart.
  • WooCommerce Test Order Generator: Generate mock test orders with customer data.
  • Custom Order Statuses: Registers custom workflow statuses like Awaiting Pickup or Shipped.

📂 User Management & Roles (10 Modules)

  • User Last Login Tracker: Displays last login timestamp and IP in Users table.
  • Force Password Change on Next Login: Requires users to reset password on login.
  • Disable New User Admin Emails: Stops admin notifications from high-volume user signups.
  • Hide Admin Bar by Role: Removes admin toolbar on frontend for specific roles.
  • Restrict /wp-admin/ by Role: Redirects non-admin roles away from wp-admin to account.
  • Secure 1-Click User Switcher: Switch between user accounts with HMAC SHA-256 tokens.
  • Enforce Display Name Format: Sets public display names to full names, hiding usernames.
  • Terminate All Active Sessions: 1-click logout for all sessions across any account.
  • Prevent Password Reset by Role: Disables password resets for restricted membership roles.
  • Default Registration Role Override: Enforces specific default roles for new user signups.

📂 Email & SMTP Delivery (11 Modules)

  • Built-in SMTP Mailer: Custom SMTP host, port, SSL/TLS, and authentication.
  • From Name & Email Override: Enforces sender name and email on outgoing emails.
  • Outbound Email Logger: Logs every wp_mail() call with recipients and subject.
  • Live SMTP Test Sender: 1-click diagnostic email sender with real-time feedback.
  • HTML Email Wrapper Template: Wraps notifications in a responsive HTML layout.
  • Disable Auto-Update Emails: Suppresses core, theme, and plugin update notifications.
  • Disable Comment Moderation Emails: Stops comment notification emails sent to administrators.
  • Alert on Profile/Email Change: Security alerts when user profile email addresses change.
  • BCC Admin on System Emails: Blind-copy administrator on system notifications.
  • Custom Email Header Logo: Injects brand logo into outgoing email headers via Media.
  • Granular Email Suppression: Selectively suppress specific system emails without code.

📂 Utilities & Maintenance (15 Modules)

  • Maintenance & Coming Soon Mode: Maintenance screen with HTTP 503 headers and whitelist.
  • Site Master Password Gate: Protects entire website behind a password with session expiry.
  • System Health Inspector: Server overview: PHP memory, MySQL version, upload limits.
  • 1-Click Database Optimizer: Cleans expired transients, spam comments, and trash.
  • Safe Database Search & Replace: Safe serialized string replacement with dry-run preview.
  • Admin Activity Audit Log: Tracks admin actions: plugin toggles and settings changes.
  • Floating Scroll to Top Button: Customizable back-to-top button on frontend and admin.
  • Clear Cache Toolbar Button: Instant transient and object cache purge button in toolbar.
  • HTTP 503 Maintenance Header: Sends proper Service Unavailable header during maintenance.
  • Settings JSON Export & Import: 1-click backup and migration of module configurations.
  • Scheduled Database Cleanup (Cron): Automated background maintenance for transients and trash.
  • Cookie Consent & GDPR Banner: Accessible GDPR/CCPA cookie notice banner.
  • Multisite Network Sync: Synchronize module settings across network sites in 1-click.
  • Plugin Auto-Rollback: Automated failsafe against fatal errors caused by updates.
  • 1-Click Database Backup: Compressed SQL database backups with optional email delivery.

Enterprise-Grade Security

  • HMAC SHA-256 Tokens for secure user switching.
  • DOMDocument XML Sanitizer with LIBXML_NONET for safe SVG uploads.
  • WP_Filesystem API for all disk operations — no eval() or move_uploaded_file().
  • Strict Nonces & Permissions on every AJAX action and setting save.
  • Complete Output Escaping across every rendered admin view.

Who Is This Plugin For?

  • Agencies & Freelancers: Configure once, export JSON presets, and deploy across client sites in seconds.
  • WooCommerce Stores: Direct checkout, mobile sticky buy bars, free shipping bars, and cart drawers.
  • Publishers & Creators: Organize media taxonomies, replace images in-place, and plan with an editorial calendar.
  • Security & Speed Seekers: 2FA TOTP, rename login URL, throttle REST abuse, and eliminate script bloat.
